PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business analyst professional with 9+ years of experience in Retail Banking, Wealth Managements, Payments & Operations, Rewards, & AML Operations and Consulting, across Canadian banking and Indian IT environments. PROJECTS:

HSBC → RBC Payments Migration (RBC Acquisition of HSBC Canada 13.5b dollar project over 1 year)

Client: RBC

Duration: Aug 2023 – Present

Role: Senior Business Initiative Analyst

Responsibilities:

Led end-to-end analysis for ACSS, Wires, Cheques, and GL reconciliations as part of HSBC → RBC Payments & Reconciliation Migration, Client Data Migration and Stake holder Management.

Drove end-to-end analysis for HSBC → RBC Payments & Reconciliation Migration, improving reconciliation accuracy by 40% through workflow redesign, GL reconciliation deep-dives, exception analysis, and financial control testing.

Supported digital transformation initiatives across retail banking operations, including payments, customer data migration, and online transaction workflows following the HSBC → RBC acquisition.

Acted as a Business Analyst for retail banking platforms, collaborating with product, technology, and operations teams to improve customer onboarding, account servicing, and digital payment experiences.

Led requirements gathering, BRDs, FRDs, workflow documentation, and data lineage mapping, resulting in enhanced stakeholder alignment and reduced defects.

Built automated Tableau dashboards and SQL pipelines that reduced manual reporting time by

6+ hours weekly and improved KPI visibility.

Analyzed customer transaction journeys across digital channels (retail payments, rewards, account activities) to identify gaps, exceptions, and process inefficiencies.

Directed UAT cycles, authored test scripts, streamlined defect triage, and improved defect closure time by 25% through structured governance.

Ensured compliance with Canadian Payment Systems by integrating operational risk controls and validation frameworks across ACSS, Wires, and payment streams.

Delivered business solutions using SAP FI/GL, ServiceNow, Symphony, and SharePoint, strengthening data accuracy and operational efficiency.

AVION & AMPLI Rewards points. Client: RBC

Duration: Aug 2023 – Present

Role: Business Initiative Analyst

Responsibilities:

Supported AML cross team operations, reconciliations, and control enhancements across financial operations and investigation workflows. Lead Reward points roll over project within RBC.

Led the Reward Points Rollover Project for AMPLI & AVION within RBC, working alongside finance, reconciliation, and technology teams.

Performed detailed reward points reconciliations, resolved payment mismatches, and improved reconciliation accuracy by 35%.

Conducted root-cause analysis on reward discrepancies, operational failures, and system exceptions to support corrective actions.

Utilized SQL, Excel (VBA & pivot models), Power BI / Tableau to build automated reports and deliver insights for leadership.

Designed process improvements and control checkpoints that enhanced customer experience, transaction accuracy, and service turnaround times.

Supported reward programs (AMPLI & AVION) by improving reconciliation logic and customer entitlement accuracy across digital channels.

Redesigned reward-processing workflows, escalation paths, and control checkpoints to enhance operational effectiveness.

Developed SOPs, workflow documents, templates, and knowledge-transfer materials to standardize processes across teams.

AML FIU (Financial Investigations Unit) Client: RBC

Duration: Aug 2023 – Present

Role: Business Initiative Analyst

Responsibilities:

Performed fraud cheque investigations and transaction reviews using TLM, ATF, PeopleSoft, Service Platform, Sibel, IRIS, and additional internal tools.

Investigated chargebacks, duplicate payments, exceptions, and adjustment express issues, resolving 40–60 complex cases per day.

Conducted Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), account monitoring, sanctions screening, Bloomberg checks, and client activity reviews for AML risk assessment.

Supported AML escalation workflows by evaluating alerts, analyzing payment patterns, and documenting case findings as per compliance guidelines.

Worked closely with AML, risk, and compliance teams to ensure secure and compliant customer onboarding and transaction monitoring within digital banking platforms.

Coordinated with risk, operations, and FIU teams during major escalations and bridge calls

until incident resolution.

Prepared and submitted CTR, CMIR, SAR, KYC reports, MIS dashboards, and summaries for loss prevention and governance teams.

Ensured adherence to AML policies, operational risk standards, and regulatory requirements while maintaining strict SLA timelines.

Retail ETL Optimization & Supply Chain Incident management – Shell Canada Client: Shell Canada

Duration: Aug 2021 – Apr 2023

Role: Business Analyst

Description:

Supported digital transformation and analytics initiatives across POS, loyalty, retail transaction systems and fuel supply chain and machine incidents.

	Gathered and documented business requirements across Retail Operations, Payments, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT teams for enhancements in POS, loyalty, pricing, and retail transaction workflows.

	Led Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews) and created user stories, acceptance criteria, and process improvement recommendations.

	Supported digital transformation initiatives across retail POS systems, customer loyalty platforms, and transaction processing systems.

	Developed project artifacts including BRDs, FRDs, AS-IS/TO-BE process maps, workflow diagrams, and data flow diagrams to support system upgrades and digital transformation initiatives.

	Conducted impact analysis, gap analysis, and risk assessments for changes to payment terminals, reconciliation workflows, inventory analytics, and store operations.

	Designed Tableau and Power BI dashboards to visualize KPIs, revenue trends, operational performance, and fraud-prone transaction patterns for business stakeholders.

	Supported SDLC and UAT activities by preparing test cases, validating system enhancements, logging defects, and coordinating with developers and SMEs to ensure successful releases.

PCI-DSS Compliance Implementation – India Client: Multiple Financial & Enterprise Clients

Duration: Nov 2017 – Aug 2021

Role: Internal Security Assessor – Cybnetic Software Solutions

Description:

Supported PCI-DSS compliance, vulnerability management, and security controls across client environments.

Responsibilities:

Conducted PCI-DSS audits, vulnerability assessments, and risk analyses, reducing identified vulnerabilities by 60%.

Managed SIEM monitoring, alert tuning, and incident analysis, improving event triage efficiency by 40%.

Coordinated penetration testing, remediation planning, and ITGC compliance activities across multiple client environments.

Administered servers, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and endpoint security tools, strengthening organization- wide security posture.

Produced audit findings, risk registers, compliance documentation, and forensic reports for internal and client stakeholders.

Delivered cybersecurity awareness training to over 300 employees, enhancing organization-wide security maturity.

Application Support & Release Stability – Cybnetic Client: Enterprise Clients

Duration: Jul 2016 – Nov 2017

Role: Associate Technical Consultant – Cybnetic Software Solutions

Description:

Provided L2/L3 support, stabilized releases, and improved operational workflows across enterprise applications.

Responsibilities:

Provided L2/L3 enterprise application support and reduced incident resolution time by 25%

through optimized prioritization.

Investigated outages, performance issues, and recurring defects using log analysis and system diagnostics.

Collaborated with development and QA teams for rapid root-cause resolution and improved release stability.

Assisted with release deployments, configuration updates, environment validations, and post- deployment review.

Collaborated with IT and operations teams to resolve customer-impacting incidents and improve digital service reliability.

Authored SOPs, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and change logs to streamline operational workflows.

Improved SLA performance by optimizing ticket routing, response patterns, and workflow automation.
